subject: [PATCH 0/8] nfsd: reduce the scope of the nfsd_mutex

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: Raised a question about whether the nfsd_netns_isolation and nfsd_netns_stress binaries were intended to be committed, prompting Jeff to clarify that they are not.

Chuck Lever (Come to NFS bake-a-thon! https://nfsv4bat.org)

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch series aims to reduce the scope of the nfsd_mutex by introducing a new per-net mutex and moving relevant data structures under it, while also giving the open file cache its own mutex. The global mutex is renamed and left for managing remaining global objects. Additionally, selftests are added to ensure proper functioning.
